title: Cache Tag Comparison (4-way)
constraints: Way i's stored tag is `way_tags[20i+19 : 20i]`. A way hits when it is valid **and** its tag equals `tag`.
`hit_onehot[i]` = way i hits. `hit` = any way hits. `hit_way` = index of the lowest hitting way (0 on a miss).
`multi_hit` = more than one way hits (a corrupted set, which should never happen and is reported for error checking).
hints: Four 20-bit equality comparators, each ANDed with its valid bit.
`hit_way` is a small priority encoder on `hit_onehot`.

examples.title: duplicate tags
examples.input: ways 1 and 3 both valid with the same tag
